question: Can the Kyujanggak catalog label 觀象監活字 or an inherited internal 印出/date statement be treated as an exact impression date for surviving GK02538?

controlling_gk02538.provider: Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies, Seoul National University
controlling_gk02538.title: 大統曆註

aks_inryeokja.title: 인력자(印曆字)
direct_public_statements: 印曆字 is also called 觀象監活字 and was used by the Gwansanggam to print calendrical books.
The exact beginning of Gwansanggam ownership/use is not known, but documentary and extant-calendar evidence reaches before the Imjin War.
The type was frequently recast, contains different iron-type forms, and was often mixed with wooden type; impressions are diverse.
aks_inryeokja.adjudication: 觀象監活字 is a functional/institutional type category with repeated recasting and multiple manifestations. The catalog label alone is not a unique identifier for the 1434 Gabinja casting event or a copy-specific impression year.

kyudb_1707_daehakyeonui.provider: Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies, Seoul National University
kyudb_1707_daehakyeonui.title: 眞西山讀書記乙集上大學衍義
kyudb_1707_daehakyeonui.catalog_scope_note: Kyujanggak explicitly labels the retained 1434 line as 衍義跋 末尾, 甲寅字本 原刊記 and separately identifies the current object as a 1707 Musinja edition.
kyudb_1707_daehakyeonui.adjudication: A later physical reprint can preserve an earlier original-imprint statement verbatim. Therefore an internal historical 印出/date statement does not, by itself, date the current physical copy.

nikh_goryeosa_jeolyo.provider: National Institute of Korean History / 한국사데이터베이스
nikh_goryeosa_jeolyo.title: 高麗史節要 金鑌跋
direct_received_text: 宣德九年九月日 … 臣金鑌…敬跋
nikh_goryeosa_jeolyo.adjudication: The same transmitted postface unit can carry a 1434 type-event postface and a distinct later explicit 印出 date. This supports separating type-event date, imprint statement, and physical-copy date.

chronology_adjudication.safe_conclusion: GK02538 may preserve early textual/postface strata while being printed in an unresolved later impression. Exact copy dating requires type/form/edition-specific evidence beyond the generic 觀象監活字 label and inherited internal dates.

unresolved_lineage_questions: Which dated Gwansanggam/印曆字 physical impressions are typographically closest to GK02538, and can a type-generation or impression window be bounded from direct form comparison?
Is the GK02538 1442 line an original imprint, copied terminal note, or another event statement?
Which securely pre-1578 witness carries the exact combined Sanming/Yueling Rainwater 後四日 and Dahan 十三後日 fingerprint?
transmission_impact.interpretation: 12EG strengthens the copy/edition chronology firewall. It explicitly prevents the institutional type label or inherited original-colophon dates from being collapsed into the surviving-copy date. No new direct transmission edge is created.

next_gate: Perform copy-specific typographic comparison against dated Gwansanggam/印曆字 impressions rather than infer from the category label.
Continue exact pre-1578 Rainwater+Dahan fingerprint search.
